data: DMG 77013 defines a couple; DMG 77102 explains household as a domestic establishment, not merely a building. Under DMG 77128, one partner entering a care home permanently is treated as no longer in the same household. Where both enter permanently, the decision maker must establish whether they remain one household on the facts. DMG 77129–77130 require reasonable independence and responsibility in running a domestic establishment; the seven factors are non-exhaustive and none is decisive alone. DMG 78089 says each may claim when household membership ends, not that an award automatically follows. Temporary absence is a separate branch.
